EIGENDYNAMICS / STUDY 021

Chromatic Unwinding

90°SQUARE

90° → 0° → 90° · Space pauses · H hides controls.

One rule, a thousand colors

Turn by θ, then walk a little farther. At 90° the increasing steps trace a square spiral. As θ approaches zero, the spiral unwinds into a line.

Inspired by fonsi’s “Een coole spiraal” (2020), presented in Snapshot.jl’s turtle notebook. This independent implementation layers nearby turn angles into colored filaments. The spread vanishes at both endpoints, preserving the square and line exactly.

The single-path mode with 101 steps reproduces the reference geometry up to scale. Auto framing fits the entire path as its size changes. The nonlinear sweep spends more time at small angles. Links restore a paused frame; MP4 export draws each frame at a fixed timestamp onto a separate square canvas, independently of real-time playback. Encoding can run slower than playback without dropping frames.
